content.class.clerk.blurb: 名册和钥匙归文书保管。今晚要把名册送上阁楼，文书就是你。
content.class.clerk.kit.0.name: 圣器室钥匙
content.class.clerk.name: 教区文书
content.obj.the-roll.hang-the-lantern.hint: 阁楼顶上垂下的那条铁链，在读经台旁边。
content.obj.the-roll.hang-the-lantern.missing_it: 链子下头是个空钩子。灯要拿在手上，挂到这里。
content.obj.the-roll.hang-the-lantern.title: 把灯挂到钩上
content.obj.the-roll.lay-the-roll.hint: 从墙边的楼梯上去，在阁楼前头的玻璃跟前。
content.obj.the-roll.lay-the-roll.missing_item_h: 读经台上空着。名册要拿在手上，放到这里。
content.obj.the-roll.lay-the-roll.title: 把名册放上读经台
content.obj.the-roll.take-the-lantern.title: 取守夜灯
content.obj.the-roll.take-the-roll.hint: 在祭坛旁的圣器室箱子里。
content.obj.the-roll.take-the-roll.title: 取征召名册
content.quest.the-roll.goal: 从圣器室的箱子里取出征召名册，从木桶里取出守夜灯，上到阁楼，把名册放上读经台，再把灯挂到读经台上方的钩子上。
content.world.outro: 名册摊在读经台上，灯在上头亮着。礼拜堂已经备好，只等天亮。
content.world.title: 一物置于一处

source.class.clerk.blurb: The clerk keeps the roll and the keys. Tonight the roll goes up to the loft, and you are the clerk.
source.class.clerk.kit.0.name: Vestry key
source.class.clerk.name: Parish Clerk
source.obj.the-roll.hang-the-lantern.hint: The chain hanging from the loft ceiling, beside the lectern.
source.obj.the-roll.hang-the-lantern.missing_it: The chain ends in an empty hook. The lantern goes here, in your hand.
source.obj.the-roll.hang-the-lantern.title: Hang the lantern on the hook
source.obj.the-roll.lay-the-roll.hint: Up the stair by the wall, against the glass at the front of the loft.
source.obj.the-roll.lay-the-roll.missing_item_h: The lectern is bare. The roll goes here, in your hand.
source.obj.the-roll.lay-the-roll.title: Lay the roll on the lectern
source.obj.the-roll.take-the-lantern.hint: The barrel at the foot of the loft stair.
source.obj.the-roll.take-the-lantern.title: Take the watch lantern
source.obj.the-roll.take-the-roll.hint: It is kept in the vestry chest beside the altar.
source.obj.the-roll.take-the-roll.title: Take the muster roll
source.quest.the-roll.goal: Take the muster roll out of the vestry chest and the watch lantern out of its barrel, climb to the loft, lay the roll on the lectern and hang the lantern on the hook above it.
source.world.outro: The roll lies open on the lectern under the lantern, and the chapel is ready for the morning.
source.world.title: An Item Laid at a Place
